capabilities: scan the vault for attachments with no local references
review and open each unused file before deciding
move selected files to the app trash after confirmation
restore trashed files to their remembered original folders
permanently delete selected files and protect files from future suggestions
disambiguation: It is not an automatic deletion tool; scans are read-only and files move only after you select and confirm them.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The interface is bilingual (English and Persian). The README recommends keeping vault backups before using any cleanup tool.
problem: Vaults accumulate screenshots, PDFs and media that are no longer linked, and deleting them by hand is risky because a file may still be referenced from properties, Canvas or Base files.
summary: Vault cleaner that finds attachments not referenced by any note, lets you review them, then trashes, restores or permanently deletes them.
